Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.html

package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.html
The Workers HTMLRewriter, with Java handlers.

HTMLRewriter.create() builds a rewriter, handlers attach with on and the onDocument* methods, and transform wraps a Response. The platform calls the handlers while the body is read, each on its own fiber, so a handler may wait.

Since:
1.0.3
